1. Does your brother cook dinner ?

9. Do you work on Saturdays ?

provenance.reference: Tata complete first submission of questions 1–12 in this chat, 13 October 2026; earlier accidental partial submission preserved separately.

conditions.instructional_context: After material, worked example and guided practice.

limits: Coach-created practice only; no IELTS/CEFR band or ability inference.

result.verification_method: Coach checks auxiliary agreement, order, subject preservation and base verb against all 12 original statements; capitalization/punctuation assessed separately. Not official IELTS key.
expected_sentences: Does a bus stop near the hotel?
Does this museum open every day?
Do I need a new phone?
Does a tour guide explain the rules?

language_conventions.reason: Names of languages take capital letters.
Possessive determiner within sentence uses lowercase; I remains capitalized when present.
Standard English punctuation attaches ? to the preceding word.

feedback.strength: All 12 question structures use correct Do/Does, original subject and base verb.
patterns: Capitalization: English versus english; my within sentence versus My.
Punctuation: remove space before question mark.
feedback.action: Check capital letters and question-mark spacing before sending the next set.
feedback.next_task: Short answers to present-simple questions: material → worked example → one guided personal question → independent practice.

result.limits: Drill accuracy after instruction, not IELTS/CEFR or evidence of long-term mastery.
